meeting_summary: The Oregon Tourism Commission Executive Director Search Subcommittee met on April 29 to introduce members, approve prior meeting minutes, record a recusal, and vote to advance five candidates to the second interview round, with plans for upcoming executive sessions and public meetings.
minutes: Chair Greg Willet called the meeting to order and welcomed attendees.
Introductions were made for Commissioners DeNovo, Grimble, Hill, Vice Chair Patel, and other participants including DOJ representative Sylvia Kramond and Heidrick & Struggles team members.
The subcommittee approved the minutes from the April 2, April 16, and April 17 meetings.
Commissioner Patel recused himself from decisions associated with the first round of interviews.
A motion was made and approved to advance candidates David Hall, Kate Sinner, Carmen Foer, Kevin Dugan, and Stacy Shaw to the second round of interviews.
The subcommittee announced that executive sessions and public meetings will be held in the coming weeks, with notice provided as required by state law.
key_decisions: Approved the April 2, April 16, and April 17 Executive Director Search Subcommittee meeting minutes.
Commissioner Patel recused himself from decisions related to the first round of interviews.
Approved advancement of candidates David Hall, Kate Sinner, Carmen Foer, Kevin Dugan, and Stacy Shaw to the next interview phase.

action_items.task: Hold executive sessions and public meetings in the coming weeks to move forward in the hiring process.
